_comment: Level scaling now runs through attributes (see attributes.json), so spellPowerPerLevel, baseMagicResistMin/Max and every <class>HpPerLevel are 0; restore them to run without attributes. Cross-class global balance numbers (not tied to one class). Read via BalanceConfig.Global(key, default). Pace knobs: resourceRegenMultiplier scales every class's passive mana/energy/focus regen (0.5 = half speed), spellCooldownMultiplier scales every per-spell cooldown (2.0 = twice as long); the per-class base rates themselves live in that class's config file as <class>ManaRegenPerSec / rogueEnergyRegenPerSec / hunterFocusRegenPerSec. Class-change re-pick policy: classChangeReselectMode 0=unrestricted (always free), 1=cooldown (once per classChangeCooldownDays), 2=admin_only (only via /canrpgclass), 3=fee (charge classChangeFee via caneconomy; needs that mod, else falls back to admin_only). The first class pick is always free.
